answer: Attention Retention Ledger. Each identity must publish a continuous sequence of verified micro-tasks whose timestamps cannot be backfilled, and the ledger only credits work that fills a velvet-smooth sliding window of recent slots. An attacker must staff every identity around the clock to keep its window warm; a lapse pushes it into a canyon of missed slots that no retroactive effort can bridge. Because idle identities decay like exposed shale, the sustained payroll for parallel fake identities exceeds what any single real operator gains.
